an5.169:1.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yenāyasmā Sāriputto ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi.
an5.169:1.2: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ etad avoca:-- 2.
an5.169:2.1: Kittāvatā nu kho āvuso Sāriputta bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu suggahitagāhī ca bahuñ ca gaṇhāti gahitañ c'assa na pamussatī ti?
an5.169:2.4: Tena h' āvuso Sāriputta suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmī ti.
an5.169:2.5: ‘Evam āvuso' ti kho āyasmā Sāriputto āyasmato Ānandassa paccassosi.
an5.169:3.1: Idhāvuso Sāriputta bhikkhu atthakusalo ca hoti dhammakusalo ca vyañjanakusalo ca niruttikusalo ca pubbāparakusalo ca.
an5.169:3.2: Ettāvatā kho āvuso Sāriputta bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu suggahitagāhī ca bahuñ ca gaṇhāti gahitañ c'assa na pamussatī ti.
an5.169:3.4: yāva subhāsitañ c' idaṃ āyasmatā Ānandena,
an5.169:3.5: imehi ca mayaṃ pañcahi dhammehi samannāgataṃ āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ dhārema
an5.169:3.6: ‘āyasmā Ānando atthakusalo dhammakusalo vyañjanakusalo niruttikusalo pubbāparakusalo'
